text:
maria: Quick heads-up — release traffic light goes yellow at 18:00 UTC tomorrow. I have a small bugfix + docs tweak in PR #5321 that I'd like to get in before tag. Can we get a late-merge exception?

sam: what's the exact risk here? is CI green?

maria: unit tests ✅, integration flaky (timeout on external mock). change is strictly additive on the client side, no schema change. tiny churn in changelog.

linda: prefer to avoid late merges during yellow. If we consider exception, need a rollback plan and a one-click revert. who would own rollback? @oncall?

raul: if it's that small and revert is trivial, i'm ok. pls include a clear changelog entry and a test that reproduces the flake in a new flaky-qa job.

charlie: +1 for exception if the deploy window has a guardrail. what's the deploy window?

maria: deploy bot says: `DevOps: scheduled tag rc-2 at 2026-03-20T18:00Z`. If we merge in next 3 hours we can get it into the tag. Otherwise it'll wait for next sprint.

linda: ok — two hard requirements: (1) add a one-line revert command in the PR description (example below), (2) add a changelog bullet under Unreleased. Without both, no.

maria: understood. adding now. revert snippet:```bash
git revert -m 1 <commit-hash> && git push origin HEAD:release-rc
```

maria: changelog line added: "fix(client): avoid nil panics on empty response — fixes #5319"

sam: CI flake still failing? can you rerun CI and paste the run id here so infra can assist.

maria: kicked again — run 938201. looks like a timeout on external mock; queued a retry and added a short stub to make test deterministic.

dev-bot: CI run 938201 rerun complete — all checks passed.

oncall: ok, oncall ack. if you merge within the next 2 hours and keep the revert snippet, i'll sign off on the exception. Leave an explicit rollback owner in the PR (someone who can revert and open a hotfix if needed).

maria: assigned rollback to me and added details to the PR. merging in ~10m. thanks all :thumbsup:

charlie: note for release notes: call out that this was a late merge exception. we'll include a postmortem entry if rollout shows regressions.

raul: thanks — keeping eyes on logs during rollout.

maria: merged. tag prep continuing.

dev-bot: Release tag task queued: rc-2 prep started (initiated by maria).
